task.name: Design Insight data models
task.subtask: 1.1 Define InsightCategory enum in raglite/shared/models.py with values: RISK, OPPORTUNITY, ANOMALY, TREND, STRATEGIC_PRIORITY
1.2 Define Insight model with fields: category, priority (1-5), summary, supporting_data (Dict), rationale, sources, recommended_action, created_at
1.3 Define InsightGenerationResult model with fields: insights (List[Insight]), total_generated, generation_method, metrics_analyzed

task.name: Implement generate_insights() function

task.name: Implement LLM-powered insight synthesis
task.subtask: 3.1 Implement synthesize_insight() helper using Mistral Large for contextual reasoning
3.2 Generate rationale combining anomalies, trends, and forecasts into coherent narrative
3.3 Generate recommended actions based on insight category
3.4 Include supporting data citations from source anomalies/trends/forecasts

task.name: Implement insight ranking and filtering
task.subtask: 4.1 Implement priority scoring algorithm: anomaly severity + trend magnitude + forecast confidence
4.2 Implement deduplication (avoid redundant insights from same underlying data)
4.3 Implement filter_insights() to limit results by category, priority, or count
4.4 Sort results by priority (ascending: 1=most critical first)

docs.doc: Defines AC1-AC6 for proactive insight generation combining anomaly detection, trend analysis, and contextual reasoning. Target: 75%+ insight usefulness.
Specifies ~50 lines integrated across modules, LLM-powered synthesis using Claude API, insight types (RISK, OPPORTUNITY, ANOMALY, STRATEGIC_PRIORITY), and NFR targets.
Mandatory patterns: type hints, Google-style docstrings, structured logging with extra={}, Pydantic models, async/await for I/O.
80%+ coverage target, pytest-asyncio for async tests, mock external dependencies, synthetic test data with known outcomes.
Learnings: insights module structure, model patterns, 69 tests achieved, LLM integration via get_mistral_client(), structured logging patterns.

constraints.constraint: Follow existing module pattern: raglite/insights/proactive.py alongside anomalies.py and trends.py
Use Pydantic BaseModel for InsightCategory enum and Insight/InsightGenerationResult models
Use get_mistral_client() from shared/clients.py for LLM synthesis (same as explain_anomaly/explain_trend)
Structured logging with extra={} for all insight generation events
Async/await for LLM calls and any I/O operations
>=80% coverage on new code per Definition of Done
Integration tests validate 75%+ insight usefulness on expert-labeled dataset
Processing time <5s for typical input (10 anomalies, 5 trends, 3 forecasts)
Target ~50-80 lines in proactive.py per Tech Spec Section 3.5 (comprehensive docstrings acceptable)
No new dependencies - use existing stdlib datetime and Pydantic

interface.name: generate_insights
interface.signature: async def generate_insights(anomalies: List[Anomaly], trends: List[Trend], forecasts: List[ForecastResult]) -> InsightGenerationResult
interface.description: Main entry point for proactive insight generation. Combines anomaly detection, trend analysis, and forecast results into prioritized actionable insights.

interface.name: synthesize_insight
interface.signature: async def synthesize_insight(anomaly: Optional[Anomaly], trend: Optional[Trend], forecast: Optional[ForecastResult]) -> Insight
interface.description: LLM-powered synthesis of individual insight with rationale and recommended action.

interface.name: calculate_insight_priority
interface.signature: def calculate_insight_priority(anomaly: Optional[Anomaly], trend: Optional[Trend], forecast: Optional[ForecastResult]) -> int
interface.description: Calculate priority score (1=critical, 5=low) based on severity, magnitude, and confidence.

interface.name: categorize_insight
interface.signature: def categorize_insight(anomaly: Optional[Anomaly], trend: Optional[Trend], forecast: Optional[ForecastResult]) -> InsightCategory
interface.description: Determine insight category based on input characteristics.

interface.name: InsightCategory
interface.signature: class InsightCategory(str, Enum): RISK, OPPORTUNITY, ANOMALY, TREND, STRATEGIC_PRIORITY

interface.name: Insight
interface.signature: class Insight(BaseModel): category, priority, summary, supporting_data, rationale, sources, recommended_action, created_at
interface.description: Pydantic model for individual proactive insight.

interface.name: InsightGenerationResult
interface.signature: class InsightGenerationResult(BaseModel): insights, total_generated, generation_method, metrics_analyzed
interface.description: Pydantic model for complete insight generation result with metadata.
